This is the leftover "home" wording after #37166 removed the Studio home: at merge-base `fbb62e1cc` (#37166's merge), `StudioRoute.tsx` still read `empty.appAccessDeniedHome`.
- **Scope:** all 17 paths are inside the claim's declared file surface: `StudioRoute.tsx`, `AiUnavailable.tsx`, the 11 locale packs, three test files and one changeset. There is no `content/docs/releases/` path and no governed path, so the PR is neither Tier H nor Tier S. 134 changed lines, under the 3,000 line.
- **Locale packs, main → head:** I imported every pack at merge-base `fbb62e1cc`, head, current `origin/main` `68250f64d6` and the merge-tree of head into main, and compared leaf-key sets. In each of the 11 packs: base → head adds `console.ai.unavailableErrorDesktop` and removes nothing (en 5040→5041, zh-Hans 5040→5041, zh-Hant/ja/ko/de 5034→5035, fr/es/pt-BR 5191→5192, ru 5348→5349, ar 5662→5663). main → merged gives the same +1/−0. The key is in 0 of 11 packs at base and 11 of 11 at head. Placeholders are consistent: neither the new key nor its sibling `console.ai.unavailableError` carries an interpolation token in any pack. Every locale hunk is a pure addition, so no existing value changed. Each translation reuses its pack's own `layout.appSwitcher.backToHome` wording (zh-Hans 「返回应用起始页」, checked in all 11).
- **Pins, own run:** throwaway worktree at this head, built the non-ui closure of `@object-ui/console` with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`, ran under `os-verify-lock`. Two earlier attempts resolved no imports (no `dist`) and ran 0 tests. I discarded both as vacuous; they are not counted.

Result: Tests 19 failed, 25 passed (44). That is the 8 StudioRoute reds the PR reports, the new desktop pin among them, plus 11 accessNotice per-language reds the PR did not report. The phone CONTROL stayed green. Restored: blob equals HEAD `eb1f53509e`.
  - Ablation 2: in `AiUnavailable.tsx`, `console.ai.unavailableErrorDesktop` was swapped to `console.ai.unavailableError` (blob `be8967064c` → `dada400011`). Result: Tests 1 failed, 13 passed (14), and the failure is the desktop pin. The phone CONTROL stayed green. Restored: blob equals HEAD `be8967064c`. The final worktree status was empty.

Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are `success`. Every required context that runs on a PR is `success`. `Build Core` is the expected path-filter skip, and the queue build widens it.
- **The dev's unrun suite** (`vitest scripts/` under ui, OOM-killed locally): covered by CI. `Plan Test UI shards` at this head ran `mode=full` with 16 of 16 shards and 7164 test files, because `@object-ui/i18n` is affected and a root setup file imports it. That set includes `scripts/**/*.test.ts`, and every Test UI shard is `success`. I accept this as a declared deviation.
- **Merge:** in a throwaway bare clone with no merge driver registered, both commits were fetched, and `git merge-tree --write-tree` of head into `origin/main` `68250f64d6` exits 0. None of the PR's paths is routed `merge=os-regen`. #37249 (head `7e70756fdd`) shares exactly the 11 locale packs. head × #37249 exits 0, and main + head + #37249 exits 0. In that three-way tree, the new key is present once in each of the 11 packs. #37249 removes only Home build-entry keys (`buildWithAI`, `welcomeAdminDescription`, the 「Build an app」 title), so every key this PR reads survives (`backToHome`, `appAccessDeniedHome`, `unavailableError`, `unavailableHome`).
- **K:** `landing-k.mjs --pr 37340` exits 3 (CAN'T ANSWER). The last green PR run (45679972228) ran no Test Core shard or planner on this ui-only diff, so no `Affected-set diff base` was printed. K is therefore NOT MEASURED by the rule's reader. Proxy: first-parent count from merge-base `fbb62e1cc` to `origin/main` `68250f64d6` is 8. That is an upper bound, because the PR run's base is no older than the merge-base, so K is below 15.
  - Locale leg: no `translations/` pack was added on main since the merge-base. Quiet.
  - Shared-budget leg: the PR touches the input of the ui eager-closure budget book (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`). Main since the merge-base touches neither that input nor `ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`. Quiet today; see N3.
- **Claim line:** `readClause2Line` on the card's newest `Claim:` (7169315159) reads `declared / yes / widening`. The PR body reads the same, and both read `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Changeset and 维护者速读:** I checked the changeset sentence by sentence against the diff. Its claims are true: the button wording, zh 「返回应用起始页」, that the sentence sits on the `/ai` screen (`AiChatPage` renders `AiUnavailable` with `hasError` when the agent catalog fails), "in every language", that the phone keeps both old texts, and "no targets / props / exports change" (the app-shell barrel is untouched and `AiUnavailable`'s props are unchanged). The level is `patch` on `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`. That is right: `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships `patch` (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3). `app-shell` is `private` but versioned (`privatePackages.version: true`). `Check Changeset` is `success`. All four lines of the 速读 are accurate: what users see, why (epic #36107), the worst case (wording only, no target change), and 「要你做什么：无」. No governed path is touched, so no human approval is owed.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

It also still walks through the Studio landing 「Studio home」 that #37166 removed. The card says this item gets no card of its own. The zone decides whether the docs/qa line rides a later PR on that file.
- N2 — The PR's ablation evidence undercounts in a safe direction. With the accessNotice harness included, ablation 1 reds 19 cases, not 8. Nothing to change.
- N3 — K is not readable by `landing-k` on this ui-only diff (exit 3). The proxy reads 8, so no merge is owed now. But #37249 also edits `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`, the input of the eager-closure budget book. If #37249 lands first, the shared-budget leg trips at any K: merge main and wait for a green re-run before arming.

- **Landing:** the zone (a4-C) lands it. Before arming: `TIER_DEFAULT` PASS record on this head (record.md, `Served-tier: TIER_DEFAULT`, Head-sha `51f74e6346188eaf35c209d02638a10d3283a363`); re-read checks on the then-current head; merge main first if K ≥ 15 or if N3's leg has tripped.

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）
